messages.subject: For Tony Douglas | Saudi aviation growth, government partnerships and strategic stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Riyadh Air Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Tony Douglas, Chief Executive Officer.

Riyadh Air's rapid expansion sits directly at the intersection of Saudi transformation, aviation regulation, international partnerships and complex stakeholder execution. That environment aligns strongly with my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, including coordination with aviation and other public authorities.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, aviation coordination and emerging-market stakeholder strategy might support Riyadh Air's growth. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Riyadh Air.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
